title: CascadeResult
description: Result of the weather-cascade fetcher. Always returns a sample — the source field discloses which tier of the cascade produced it (live NWS, live Open-Meteo, or the deterministic simulated fallback). Audit envelope's source_chain + sources_tried + fallback_reason carry the full chain provenance.

tempC.description: Dry-bulb air temperature in degrees Celsius.

windMps.description: Wind speed in meters per second. Optional — not all sources expose it.

source.description: Which source produced this sample. 'simulated' indicates both live sources failed and the deterministic fallback fired.
